en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Drinking coffee after a meal
Sleeping after a meal
Exercising after a meal

Atua has spoken...
Coffee is too bitter to drink.

Hmmm... Maybe you and Atua aren't
so compatible after all.

If you sleep after a meal, you're more likely
to get sacrificed, y'know?

Unless you wanna serve Atua by being
a sacrifice? Hmmm?
I'll do it whenever you're ready, okay?

Nyahaha! You're divine as ever, Shuichi.
Atua recommends exercising after meals.

The odds of getting sacrificed shoot way up
if you sleep right after a meal.

Say, how do you know so much about my
island?

Oh! Were you a prince on my island
in a past life!?

Then we were fated to meet each other!
No wonder you have Atua's favor!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
